title: Roles & Permissions list page loads with the correct columns and Create button
expected: Heading 'Roles & Permissions' with NO subtitle; 6 labeled columns Role Name, Description, Template, Role Type, Users, Action + leading icon column; blue Create button
actual: Page heading reads 'Roles & Permissions' with no subtitle beneath. Table shows a leading unlabeled icon column (holds lock for system roles) then 6 labeled columns in order: Role Name (sortable), Description, Template, Role Type (sortable), Users (sortable), Action. A 'Create custom role' button is present with white text on blue (rgb(56,116,255)).
reason: Matches expected: heading, no subtitle, column set/order, and blue Create button all present.

title: All 11 system roles appear in the list with System badge
expected: 11 system roles present; every system row shows a System badge; every custom row shows a Custom badge
actual: All 11 system roles present: Technician, Senior Service Advisor, Parts Manager, Time Clock, Foreman, Parts Tech, Service Manager, Admin, Office, Sales Representative, Service Advisor. Every system row's Role Type shows a 'system' badge (text-transform: capitalize -> displays 'System', light blue rounded). Custom rows show 'custom' -> 'Custom' badge. Note: the list uses short labels (Admin/Parts Tech/Time Clock) rather than the long names in the case text, but all 11 system roles are present with correct badges.
reason: Matches expected: 11 system roles with System badges and custom roles with Custom badges. Short vs long label form is covered separately by 26340.

title: Create Custom Role opens the 'Choose a template' modal
expected: Modal 'Choose a template' with subtitle, template cards, Skip + Apply + close(x)
actual: Clicking 'Create custom role' opens a modal titled 'Choose a template' with subtitle 'Start from a template to pre-fill settings, or skip to start from scratch.' It lists the system-role template cards and has 'Skip' and 'Apply' buttons plus a close (x).

title: Custom role row exposes pencil (edit) and three-dot menu; View Permissions is inside the menu
expected: Custom row shows pencil + three-dot; no standalone eye; View Permissions inside the menu
actual: Custom role rows expose a pencil (edit) icon and a three-dot (more_vert) menu, with NO standalone eye/visibility icon. Opening the three-dot menu on a custom row shows 'View Permissions' (and 'Delete'). Standalone eye icon appears only on locked system rows (Office, Time Clock).

title: Administrator system role row shows a lock icon and only the eye icon in Actions
expected: Step 3: The Settings/App Settings/Service/Parts/Finance/Data Import/View Manage Wages permissions can NOT be toggled off
actual: Opened the Admin role in the editor (pencil). Scrolled to the Settings toggles. The Settings-area toggles (e.g. App Settings) are ON and disabled (aria-disabled=true); clicking App Settings did NOT turn it off - it remained checked. 7 toggles disabled and a 'Full administrative access' banner is shown. Permissions cannot be toggled off.
reason: EXP met: Admin's core Settings permissions cannot be toggled off. (Case title mentions lock/eye-only which is stale - Admin is editable via pencil - but the graded Expected about non-toggleable permissions passes.)

title: Office system role is non-editable (lock icon, eye-only actions)
expected: Lock icon left of 'Office'; Actions shows only the eye icon; clicking eye opens read-only Permission Summary
actual: Office row shows a lock icon in the leading icon column and the Actions column shows only the eye (visibility) icon - no pencil, no three-dot. Clicking the eye navigates to /administration/roles-permissions/{id}/summary and opens a 'View Permissions' panel (class permission-summary) showing Office's name, description and grouped permissions with NO save/update controls (read-only).
reason: Matches expected: lock + eye-only + read-only Permission Summary.

title: Time Clock User system role is non-editable (lock icon, eye-only actions)
expected: Lock icon left of 'Time Clock User'; Actions shows only the eye icon; clicking eye opens read-only Permission Summary
actual: Time Clock row (UI displays 'Time Clock') shows a lock icon and only the eye (visibility) icon in Actions. Clicking the eye opens the read-only 'View Permissions' summary (/{id}/summary) for Time Clock with no save controls. Note: UI label is 'Time Clock', not 'Time Clock User'.
reason: Matches expected: lock + eye-only + read-only summary. Only difference is the display label form.

title: Users column shows a clickable count linking to the filtered Staff page
expected: Nonzero count = blue clickable number linking to /administration/staff?roleName=; zero = non-clickable red 0
actual: Nonzero user counts render as blue clickable numbers wrapped in <a href='/administration/staff?roleName=<RoleName>'> (e.g. Technician=65, Admin=93 link to the filtered Staff page). Zero-user roles show a red '0' with no link (not clickable), e.g. custom roles with 0 users.

title: Search field filters the Roles list live
expected: Search field with floating label 'Search Role'; list filters live as you type
actual: The search field is a floating-label 'Search Role' input with a magnifier icon (no HTML placeholder). Typing 'Technician' filtered the list live from 32 rows down to 1 row ('Technician').
reason: Matches expected: live filtering with floating label.

title: 'Locations' appears under the SETTINGS sidebar group (build-observed; not in this spec)
expected: SETTINGS group shows Settings, Staff, Roles & Permissions, Locations, Departments, Taxes; Locations between Roles & Permissions and Departments
actual: The left sidebar SETTINGS group shows, in order: Settings, Staff, Roles & Permissions, Locations, Departments, Taxes. 'Locations' (location_on icon) is present between 'Roles & Permissions' and 'Departments'.

title: Roles list shows a 'Template' column (per SV-7499 description)
expected: A 'Template' column is present; system rows show their own template, custom rows show the source system template
actual: A 'Template' column IS present (not missing, so no bug to file per Step 4). System role rows show their own name as template (e.g. Admin->Admin, Technician->Technician). Custom role rows show the source template they were created from (e.g. 'Mudassir Test Role 6'->Sales Representative, 'Mudassir Test Role 3'->Office); some older customs show 'Custom'. Note: actual column order is Role Name, Description, Template, Role Type, Users, Action - Description and Type are ordered differently than the Step-1 order in the case, but the Template column exists with correct values.
reason: Template column present with correct system/custom values, satisfying the SV-7499 requirement (Step 4 bug not needed). Minor column-order wording discrepancy noted.

title: Each of the 11 system roles shows its canonical description
expected: 11 system roles; descriptions match the canonical spec strings
actual: 11 system roles present. Descriptions match canonical: Admin 'Full system access'; Service Manager 'Full operational access, limited admin (App Settings + Wages only)'; Senior Service Advisor 'Work order and customer management with expanded access'; Service Advisor 'Work order and customer management with invoicing access'; Foreman 'Oversees technicians and work orders'; Technician 'Assigned work orders and time tracking (Tech View)'; Parts Manager 'Full parts and inventory control'; Parts Tech 'Parts operations and vendor management'; Office 'Office administration, reporting, and back-office operations'; Sales Representative 'Reports and financial data access only'; Time Clock 'Clock in/out only'.
reason: Matches expected: 11 roles with canonical descriptions.

title: Custom role with no description shows a literal '-'
expected: Blank-description custom role shows a literal hyphen '-' in the Description column
actual: Custom roles with no admin-entered description show a literal '-' in the Description column (e.g. 'Mudassir Test Role 6', 'A - Custom', 'Milos Testing Role', 'Mudassir Test Role 1' all show '-'), while custom roles with a description show their text.

title: Editable system-role three-dot menu exposes only 'View Permissions' (no Duplicate)
expected: Editable system-role three-dot menu contains only 'View Permissions'; no Duplicate; Edit is a separate pencil
actual: Opened the three-dot (more_vert) menu on the editable system role Admin: it contains only 'View Permissions'. No 'Duplicate' item. Edit is a separate pencil icon in the Action column.

title: Custom-role three-dot menu exposes 'View Permissions' and 'Delete'
expected: Custom-role three-dot menu contains 'View Permissions' and 'Delete' (red trash); no Duplicate; Edit is separate pencil
actual: Opened the three-dot menu on custom role 'A - Custom': items are 'View Permissions' and 'Delete' (Delete shown in red with a trash icon). No 'Duplicate'. Edit is a separate pencil icon, not in the menu.

title: No 'Duplicate' action exists on the Roles list
expected: No 'Duplicate' action anywhere (system or custom menus)
actual: No 'Duplicate' action exists anywhere on the Roles list. Editable-system three-dot menu = 'View Permissions' only; custom three-dot menu = 'View Permissions' + 'Delete'. A DOM scan found 0 elements with the exact text 'Duplicate'.

title: Editable system role row shows pencil (edit), three-dot menu, and eye icons — no lock
expected: Actions column shows pencil (edit), eye (view), AND three-dot menu icons on editable system rows; no lock
actual: Editable system rows (Technician, Service Manager, Foreman, etc.) show a pencil (edit) icon and a three-dot (more_vert) menu, and NO lock icon - but there is NO standalone eye/view icon. 'View Permissions' is inside the three-dot menu (consistent with case 26310). A standalone eye icon appears only on locked rows (Office, Time Clock).
reason: stale case - UI evolved: editable system rows do not show a standalone eye icon; View Permissions lives inside the three-dot menu (matches 26310). No-lock part is correct, but the standalone-eye expectation is contradicted. Underlying behavior is correct/consistent.

title: Three-dot menu is hidden on non-editable system roles (Administrator, Office, Time Clock User)
expected: Administrator, Office, and Time Clock User rows show only the eye icon (three-dot menu hidden, no pencil)
actual: Office and Time Clock rows are eye-only (lock + visibility only, no pencil/three-dot) as expected. However the Administrator (Admin) row is EDITABLE: it has a pencil AND a three-dot menu (no lock, no standalone eye). So Admin's three-dot menu is NOT hidden.
reason: Contradicts EXP for the Administrator row: in the current build Admin is editable (pencil + three-dot 'View Permissions'), not eye-only. Only Office and Time Clock are non-editable. The case itself flags this Admin uncertainty (post-6/10 Owner removal) - likely intended behavior, flag for product; Office/Time Clock parts pass.

title: Administration / sidebar Roles & Permissions item hidden for users without Settings: App Settings
role_used: Tech (role with only scheduleView/timesheetsView/workOrdersView, no App Settings)
expected: SETTINGS group does not appear, or 'Roles & Permissions' item is not present under it
actual: Logged in as the Tech user (effective fe_permissions = scheduleView, timesheetsView, workOrdersView; no App Settings). The left sidebar shows NO SETTINGS group at all and NO 'Roles & Permissions' item anywhere (DOM scan found neither).
reason: Matches expected: without Settings:App Settings the SETTINGS group and Roles & Permissions item are hidden.
